privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.description: What kefche keeps about you, where it is stored and how to download or delete it.
privacy.intro: kefche is a free games site with no ads. This short notice explains what we keep about you and why. A full privacy policy will replace it as the site grows.

stored.title: What we keep
stored.account: If you create an account: your email address, your password (kept only as a secure hash by our database provider), your nickname and avatar, and the country and bio you choose to add. We also keep your birth year, only to check that you are 13 or older.
stored.guest: If you play online without an account: a random guest ID and the nickname you pick.
stored.settings: Your settings, such as language, theme, sound and privacy choices.
stored.rooms: The online rooms you join: your seat, the moves of each match and when you were last connected. A room's records are deleted as soon as its last player leaves.
stored.rated: Rated games (accounts only): while a game is on, each move with the time our server received it, so the server can work out the result itself. Then the finished game (the players, the result and the moves) and your rating, which anyone can see. Deleting your account deletes your ratings, and your name disappears from the games you played.
stored.games: Your games (accounts only): each game you finish and its result, which anyone can see on your profile with your stats for each game (games played, wins, best scores and times). To check results, our server keeps the moves of the games you play on your device and of your races for 90 days, and in an online room the result you saw for 2 days, to compare it with the other players'. Your games earn XP and achievements, and your level and achievements show on your profile; the XP you earned each day is kept 35 days, for the daily limits and the weekly XP board. Your nickname, your best results, your ratings and your XP appear on the leaderboards, unless you turn that off in settings. Your play streak (the days in a row you've played) only you can see; the avatar frame you choose shows with your avatar. As a guest, your games stay on your device.
stored.chat: Lobby chat messages, deleted together with their room.
stored.friends: Friends (accounts only): your friends and friend requests, which only you and they can see, and the players you block, which only you can see. They're deleted with your account.
stored.invites: Invites (accounts only): an invite to a room is kept as a notice for the player invited, and deleted when the room closes. Who can invite you is your choice in settings: everyone (the default), friends only or nobody.
stored.notifications: Notifications (accounts only): friend requests, invites, achievements, rating milestones, daily challenge results and notices about your account, which only you can see. They're deleted after 90 days. Which ones you get is your choice in settings.
stored.presence: Online status (accounts only): whether you're online, in a lobby or a game (and which game) or away, as your open tabs report it. Each tab's report is deleted 2 minutes after its last one, so nothing is kept once you leave. Who sees it is your choice in settings: everyone, friends only (the default) or nobody.
stored.moderation: Moderation: chat messages are checked for blocked words, which are hidden. Three hidden in 10 minutes mute you for 10 minutes, so we note each one for those 10 minutes. A warning, mute, suspension or ban you receive is kept with its reason and end while your account exists, and we send you a notice about it (notices are deleted after 90 days).
stored.security: Security records: limits on how often an action can be repeated, and a log of important account changes. Where these need your IP address, we keep only a salted hash of it, never the address itself.

device.title: On your device
device.storage: Your browser keeps your sign-in session, settings, best scores and unfinished games in its own storage, and a cookie remembers the language you chose. They stay on your device until you clear them.
device.tracking: We use no advertising, no analytics and no tracking cookies.

processors.title: Who handles it
processors.supabase: Our database, sign-in, file storage and account emails run on Supabase, in the European Union (Frankfurt, Germany).
processors.cloudflare: Cloudflare delivers the site and sees the technical details every web request carries, such as your IP address.

choices.title: Your choices
choices.export: Download a copy of your data, or delete your account, in Settings. Deletion happens after 7 days, so you can change your mind; then your account and your files are erased.
choices.guests: Guest IDs that go unused for 30 days are deleted automatically.
choices.age: You must be 13 or older to create an account.

contact.title: Questions
contact.issues: For now, questions about privacy go to the project's issue tracker on GitHub. It is public, so please don't post personal details there. To see or remove your own data, use Settings.
